Removing corrupt officials can theoretically improve operational efficiency, provided the process is not merely a tool for political purges.

This is a classic power consolidation move. By framing the removal of rivals as an anti-corruption effort, the leadership avoids scrutiny while replacing independent actors with loyalists.

The Trajectory: The Path of Reckoning.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. The centralization of force creates a high-strain, fragile system.
